properties.description: The ID of the object, referenceable using a URI fragment
Human readable label for the object
Human readable description of the object
Specifies if the value of a data component can be updated externally (i.e., is variable)
Specifies if the data for this component can be omitted in the datastream
The definition of the property whose value is provided by this component (semantic link)
Frame of reference (usually temporal or spatial) with respect to which the value of the component is expressed. A reference frame anchors a value to a real world datum.
Specifies the reference axis (refer to CRS axisID). The reference frame URI should also be specified unless it is inherited from parent Vector
Defines reserved values with special meaning (e.g., missing, out-of-range, etc.)
Inline value(s) for the component. This property is optional to enable structure to act as a schema for values provided separately (e.g., in a datastream)
